reviews.title: 26 · Hidden fringe roots and embedded optical eyes
reviews.note: The detached fringe roots are hidden and individual fibers now end at varied lengths. Eye sockets are shallower, though lower eyelid transitions remain too raised. Side view is coherent; skin, tailoring and hair flow are still stylized rather than reference-level realism.

reviews.title: 25 · Continuous crown without exposed scalp gaps
reviews.note: The crown gaps and bright part seam are removed, and front tips are layered. Rear continuity is preserved. Close-up still shows overly deep inner eye sockets, geometric fringe roots and simplified skin.

reviews.title: 24 · Rear continuity and softer facial relief
reviews.note: The rear gap is closed and the nasal transition is softer. Portrait and detail still expose crown triangles, a bright scalp seam, rigid fringe, and simplified skin. Four views rendered without browser errors.

reviews.title: 23 · Recovered continuation: crown gaps remain
reviews.note: Reviewed portrait, left and back. Facial placement improved, but root gaps, a rear seam, overly uniform hair and flat skin remain. This is not the target quality.

reviews.title: 22 · Volumetric highlights — root-strip regression
reviews.note: Added view-responsive fiber highlights and varied volumetric locks. The reflection test exposes triangular root-strip artifacts and an overly bright part line, so this pass is not accepted as final.

reviews.title: 21 · Dimensional eyelids and embedded eyes
reviews.note: Added rounded skin margins, contact-shaded ocular surfaces and varied tapered eyelashes. The eyes sit more convincingly in the face; the upper lashes are too reflective, and the crown remains too uniformly combed.

reviews.title: 20 · Smoother anatomy and neutral dark-brown fibers
reviews.note: Rebuilt eyebrow growth, stabilized the orbital transition, refined the nose and lip proportions, and restored a neutral hair color. Geometry checks pass. The eyelid margins, uniform groom and cloth shading still prevent a high-fidelity likeness score.

reviews.title: 19 · Fuller hair coverage and feathered crop
reviews.note: Moved the front hair masses inward, hid the far ear, shortened the tips and added finer hairline growth. The bright fiber trial introduced an unwanted pink cast and still reads as too uniformly combed; these defects remain visible.

reviews.title: 18 · Continuous root flow — uniformity regression
reviews.note: Removed the disconnected scalp bands and matched roots to a continuous rear volume. Four-view review reveals hair that is too uniform, front masses too far outward, and tips that extend below the crop. This is an intermediate geometry pass, not the target quality.

reviews.title: 17 · Face proportions, skin atlas and reflective eyes
reviews.note: Widened the cheeks, increased lip fullness, raised the portrait camera, and authored anatomical skin and iris maps. The first refractive-eye trial stalled the software renderer; the lighter reflective layer rendered successfully. The banded crown remains the primary flaw.

reviews.title: 16 · Darker groom and continuous ear anatomy
reviews.note: Darkened the hair toward the reference and replaced layered ear tubes with continuous sculpted volumes. Root strips still read as separate bands; a new continuous root-flow surface is needed.

reviews.title: 15 · Rounded tailoring and sewn collar
reviews.note: Rebuilt the blouse with rounded set-in sleeves, a thick rolled collar, woven surface detail and conforming stitched placket. The hair-root bands and overall facial realism remain below the target.

reviews.title: 14 · Hair volume and ear visibility
reviews.note: Restored the tucked-ear silhouette, filled the chest-length hair masses, and improved strand antialiasing. Broad root bands remain visibly artificial; the blouse is still the older angular version.

reviews.title: 13 · Groom trial — scalp intersection regression
reviews.note: Facial normals and lip edges are smoother. The new groom exposes scalp intersections and undersized front masses; this trial is not accepted as the final hairstyle.

reviews.title: 12 · Continuous facial surface
reviews.note: Rebuilt the face with exact eye openings and embedded nasal and lip relief. Removed visible orbital patches; hair, collar, skin response, and eyelid micro-shading still need work.

reviews.title: 11 · Lighting correction, unresolved anatomy
reviews.note: Reviewed the saved continuation render. Skin contrast improved, but rectangular eye gaps, orbital seams, stiff hair and angular cloth remain.

reviews.title: 10 · Surface and lighting regression
reviews.note: Added procedural skin normals and denser hair, but excessive environment fill washed out facial contrast. That lighting regression is being corrected.

reviews.title: 09 · Portrait proportions
reviews.note: Better lower-face length, crown volume, and shoulder width. The dominant remaining gaps are skin response, hair-root flow, and collar placement.

reviews.title: 08 · Soft tissue and fringe
reviews.note: Softer facial transitions and asymmetric fringe. Photorealistic skin and hair still need substantial refinement.

reviews.title: 07 · Spherical eyes and sockets
reviews.note: Rebuilt the eye surfaces and facial openings; close-up review identified stiff lid edges, high brows, and repetitive fringe.

reviews.title: 06 · Hair shading and ear visibility
reviews.note: Added procedural strand microdetail, directional lighting, and a left-ear hair tuck. The face still reads as stylized rather than photorealistic.

reviews.title: 05 · Eye depth and proportions
reviews.note: Corrected iris occlusion, widened neck and shoulders, and softened garment folds. Hair remains too sculpted and skin too uniform.

reviews.title: 04 · Continuous facial surface
reviews.note: Removed the facial seam and improved the chin. Eye depth and scalp detail still need refinement.

reviews.title: 03 · Volume and anatomy
reviews.note: Added fuller front hair; a lower-face transition seam was identified.

reviews.title: 02 · Eyes, coverage & crop
reviews.note: Fixed occluded irises and scalp intersections; darkened hair; shortened crop. Front hair, facial curvature and eyelids remain too stylized.
